review_request.note: The named pack reviewer (owner decision 2026-10-22). Recording the reviewer does not mark the pack reviewed: the pack stays draft until the reviewer runs the 0081 review flow.

metrics.name: rebate_rate
metrics.description: Annualized rebate paid to the borrower on cash collateral (lender pays); fee = benchmark rate minus rebate
metrics.rationale: 0113 REQ-008 lists rebate rate; the pack has only borrow_fee, and 0063 forbids treating fee and rebate as interchangeable.

metrics.name: lendable_value
metrics.description: Market value available to lend at a point in time (the utilization denominator)
metrics.rationale: The pack defines utilization as value on loan divided by lendable value but has no lendable_value measure to divide by.

metrics.name: on_loan_quantity
metrics.description: Shares or nominal on loan at a point in time
metrics.rationale: 0113 REQ-008 lists on-loan quantity; reviewed exemplars compute it.

metrics.name: lendable_quantity
metrics.description: Shares or nominal available to lend at a point in time
metrics.rationale: 0113 REQ-008 lists lendable quantity; reviewed exemplars compute it.

metrics.name: recall_quantity
metrics.description: Quantity under open recall at a point in time
metrics.rationale: 0113 REQ-008 lists recall quantity; recall and buy-in workflows (W3) need it.

metrics.name: collateral_value
metrics.description: Market value of collateral received against loans at a point in time
metrics.rationale: 0113 REQ-008 lists collateral value; collateral coverage and margin checks need it.

metrics.name: days_to_cover
metrics.description: Shares on loan divided by average daily trading volume
metrics.rationale: 0113 T-033 lists days-to-cover for recall and squeeze risk (W3).

dimensions.name: counterparty
dimensions.description: Borrowing counterparty (lender viewpoint); identity is a restricted redaction class
dimensions.rationale: The pack's client dimension is the prime client or lender; the agency-lender deployment slices on-loan and recalls by borrower.
